tldr: The causal unrestricted treatment value has a sharp honest interval benchmark under quadratic decay of treatment exposure. In the anchored Bernoulli model, \(n^{3/7}\ell_n(H;q)\) converges to the full-honesty weighted Gaussian connected-interval value \(L(H)\), uniformly over all feasible cubic evaluation centers \(q_{a,c}\) in the stated parameter rectangle and all \(H\) in any fixed compact positive interval. A terminating computation gives outward-certified brackets for this public-radius function. One jointly Borel data-only family attains the same limit while covering the value over all \(\mathcal F\) at every sample size; no center, knot, coefficient, or center value is supplied. Whether arbitrary confidence sets can attain the connected-interval value remains a separate unresolved question.
